question: Can the Chainlink TWAP mid-band engine run on every coin and 5m/15m/1H without mixing settlement rules?

5m.engine: same as live BTC/ETH 5m: Chainlink 60s TWAP vs window-open PTB

15m.engine: same oracle; window_seconds=900; keep last-280s entry (not a 5m clock copy of 280/300)

1h.resolutionSource: Binance spot/futures candle close vs open
1h.engine: NEVER this TWAP hunter. Chainlink-vs-PTB on a Binance-candle market is the ~9 bps basis hole.

holes_if_telegram_opens_all_coins_and_5m: parse_5m only matched btc|eth 5m, so 15m/SOL/XRP scanned but never entered — silent no-trade, not a wrong-oracle fill
WINDOW_SECONDS and left>305 were 5m-only; a naive 15m hunt would mis-time PTB and leftover seconds
tag=1H leaks 5m/15m slugs plus true hourly Binance books; scan_limit=24 can crowd BTC/ETH 5m off the WS set
favorite_same_window_open locked same 5m timestamp across coins, not same asset across 5m vs 15m
KEEP_SECONDS=900 equals one 15m window, so pre-T0 ticks can fall out before a late 15m PTB reread
opening 1H and applying TWAP vs PTB would trade the wrong settlement source

top_logic.source_of_truth: settlement URL / slug grammar, not Telegram tags
top_logic.hunt: parse_window 5m/15m AND asset has Chainlink RTDS symbol AND tag 5M/15M is on

params_kept.note: 280s on 15m is the last 4.7m of a 900s clock — late window, not early-window 15m spam

top_logic.crowding: pick_markets ranks twap_ok ahead of hourly two-ask books
top_logic.inventory: one TWAP book per asset; one asset per same-horizon clock
top_logic.do_not_patch: live sqlite tags/assets stay 5M + btc/eth unless the owner taps Telegram
